description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller advice for handling exceptions related to the checkout service, mapping them to appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot advice class for handling exceptions and mapping them to HTTP responses

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles CheckoutValidationException and returns a 400 Bad Request with error details

methods.name: handleBeanValidation
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException and returns a 400 Bad Request with a validation failure message

methods.name: handleOrchestration
methods.description: Handles CheckoutOrchestrationException and returns a 502 Bad Gateway with error details
